tldr: North Node in House 11: growth through community, networks, future plans, collaboration, and collective purpose.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop community, networks, future plans, collaboration, and collective purpose. The South Node in House 5 shows the familiar life field: personal drama, recognition hunger, romance, or solo performance. The house axis describes where the growth has to become lived, not just understood. The practice is to put personal gifts in service of a wider field.
business: Growth becomes practical when the person chooses community, networks, future plans, collaboration, and collective purpose in the concrete house topics of daily life.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in House 5 can pull the person back toward personal drama, recognition hunger, romance, or solo performance.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node house names the growth field; South Node house names the familiar field. Requires accurate birth time for house placement.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
